# VMate Music Player

> VMate Music Player is a free, offline-first iOS music player app. It lets iPhone users play local audio files without an internet connection, and includes a 10-band equalizer with bass boost, live synced lyrics, hi-res lossless playback, folder-based library browsing, instant search, custom playlists and an immersive Now Playing screen. The app contains no ads and is available in 18 languages.

VMate Music Player is developed by VMate Labs. It is a Music application for iOS (iPhone), free to download with optional in-app purchases and subscriptions (VMate Pro) that unlock the full equalizer, bass boost, hi-res audio output and live lyrics. The app has a 4.9-star App Store rating from over 12,800 ratings and 200,000+ downloads. It is privacy-first: no account required, no personal data collected, no ads, and music never leaves the device.

## Key facts
- **App name:** VMate Music Player (also: VMate)
- **Developer:** VMate Labs
- **Category:** Music (iOS / iPhone)
- **Price:** Free, with optional VMate Pro in-app purchases and subscriptions
- **In-app purchase from:** $2.99
- **Rating:** 4.9 / 5 (12,847 ratings)
- **Downloads:** 200,000+
- **Languages:** 18 (English, Arabic, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese-Brazil, Dutch, Turkish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Polish)
- **Offline:** Yes — fully offline-first playback
- **Ads:** None, in free or paid versions
- **Tracking:** None — no analytics or advertising SDKs

## Core features
- Offline playback of local audio files (no signal required)
- 10-band equalizer with presets, bass boost and 3D surround
- Live, synced lyrics on an immersive Now Playing screen
- Hi-res / lossless audio output
- Library organization: albums, artists, folders and playlists
- Instant search with smart filters and genre browsing
- Custom playlist creation with drag-and-drop
- No advertisements, ever
- 18-language localization

## Audience
iPhone owners who want a premium, private, ad-free way to play their local music library offline — including frequent travellers, audiophiles who want equalizer control and lossless output, and listeners who value privacy (no tracking, no account).
